name: Residential Charging Solutions Rebate
description: Up to 50% off approved home EV charging equipment; income-qualified customers can get up to $2,000 for installation or up to $5,000 with a panel upgrade
fullDescription: PG&E's Residential Charging Solutions Rebate helps customers pay for PG&E-approved home EV charging equipment, with larger Rebate Plus amounts for income-qualified customers covering installation and panel upgrades.
whatTheyOffer:
- Standard rebate: up to 50% of the purchase price of approved charging equipment
- Rebate Plus (income-qualified): up to $2,000 for charger installation
- Rebate Plus: up to $5,000 for a panel upgrade plus charger installation
- Covers approved chargers, energy management systems, and smart splitters
- One rebate per household, first-come, first-served
howToGetIt:
1. Must be an active PG&E residential customer who owns or leases a BEV or PHEV registered in California
2. For Rebate Plus: household income under 80% of area median income, enrollment in programs like CalFresh, Medi-Cal, or SSI, or a recent PG&E Pre-Owned EV Rebate
3. Choose PG&E-approved charging equipment
4. Have it installed by a licensed electrician (Rebate Plus uses PG&E's Trade Ally Network)
5. Apply within 180 days of equipment purchase
keywords: EV charger, rebate, PG&E, electric vehicle, charging, Level 2, CARE, FERA, installation, home charging
